Application Data.NAME: Secure Storage Solutions, LLC
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Secure Storage Blvd, Suite 100, Springfield, IL 62704-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Secure Storage Solutions, LLC operates a state-of-the-art self-storage facility in Springfield, IL, offering various unit sizes equipped with 24/7 electronic access control, video surveillance, and well-maintained fire detection and suppression systems. Our facility is constructed with fire-resistant materials and features a rigorous maintenance program, including regular pest control and prompt repairs. Additionally, we have strict policies against the storage of perishable goods, live animals, and hazardous materials, ensuring a safe environment for all tenants. We prioritize customer service and tenant satisfaction, providing on-site staff for assistance and security monitoring.
